translation.about_intro: I'm <highlight>Ilyas</highlight>, a Junior <bold>Full Stack</bold> Developer with a strong focus on backend architecture and security. Trained in the intensive, peer-to-peer environment of <bold>1337 Coding School (42 Network)</bold> and holding a <bold>DTS</bold> from <bold>OFPPT</bold>, I thrive on solving complex algorithmic challenges. I specialize in building robust, scalable applications. <bold>I am deeply passionate about cybersecurity</bold> and continuously explore the world of ethical hacking. Driven by a "security-first" mindset, my ultimate goal is to leverage technology to build secure, efficient solutions that make a real-world impact, particularly in the healthcare sector.
translation.project_clickshop_desc: A specialized Cash on Delivery (COD) e-commerce platform built for the Moroccan market. It features a serverless architecture using Google Sheets for real-time order management and integrates advanced Facebook Pixel events for ad optimization.
translation.project_portfolio_desc: My personal professional portfolio website to showcase my skills, experience, and projects. Designed with a clean, responsive UI using the latest web technologies.
translation.project_movie_desc: An interactive movie discovery application that allows users to search for movies, view details, and ratings using the TMDB API.
translation.project_quickfood_desc: A high-performance monorepo platform featuring a Laravel 11 REST API and a React 18 frontend. Implements secure Sanctum authentication, advanced filtering systems, and a fully automated CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions for rigorous testing.
translation.project_devishub_desc: A cloud-native SaaS platform designed to digitalize and centralize quote, product, and client management for SMEs. Built with a strict API-first monorepo architecture featuring robust multi-tenancy data isolation.
translation.contact_into:
Ready to build something secure, scalable, and impactful?
Whether you have an idea that needs a solid technical backbone, an existing backend that requires an upgrade, or you simply want to talk tech and cybersecurity, my inbox is always open.
translation.footer_text: "Passionate about mastering modern developer tools and building high-performance architectures."
